description: Source code for the HS300X sensor driver in Zephyr RTOS, implementing temperature and humidity measurement via I2C.

methods.name: hs300x_read_sample
methods.description: Reads temperature and humidity sample data from the sensor via I2C.

methods.name: hs300x_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches a new sample from the sensor, initiating measurement.

methods.name: hs300x_temp_convert
methods.description: Converts raw temperature data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: hs300x_rh_convert
methods.description: Converts raw humidity data to sensor_value format.

methods.name: hs300x_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature or humidity value based on the channel.

methods.name: hs300x_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checking I2C readiness.
